Timeout reached: Blob storage chunk did not respond in 30000ms
##[warning]Failed to download artifact after 5 retries due to undefined. Retrying in 5 seconds...
##[error]Artifact download failed after 5 retries.

##[error]Download failed for artifact 'openvino_wheels': Unable to download and extract artifact: Artifact download failed after 5 retries.
root_cause: Eight independent merge-queue jobs (PyTorch/TensorFlow/JAX Layer and Models tests, Keras 3, C++ unit tests) all failed at the same 'Download OpenVINO artifacts' step with an identical error: the GitHub Actions blob storage backend stopped responding to a data chunk mid-download, tripping a 30-second per-chunk timeout after 5 retries. This is not caused by the PR's code changes (which only touch GPU unit test random-number generation helpers); it is a GitHub-hosted Actions/Azure Blob Storage transient outage affecting artifact download across many concurrent jobs in the same run.
reproduction_steps: N/A - not reproducible locally; transient GitHub Actions artifact storage backend issue.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed jobs; a plain retry is expected to succeed once the blob storage backend recovers.
If retries continue to fail, check the GitHub Status page (githubstatus.com) for ongoing Actions/Artifacts incidents.
No code changes are required in PR #38007.
prevention_strategies: Consider adding retry/backoff wrapping around the artifact download action, or splitting very large artifacts (openvino_wheels) into smaller pieces to reduce the chance of a single chunk stalling past the timeout window.
historical_context: A related but distinct pattern (upload to blob storage returning an HTML error page during finalizeArtifact) was recorded on 2026-09-04 for PR #37898 (pattern 841a57c639e28d01). This is the first recorded occurrence of the download-side chunk timeout signature.
